Subject: RE: Fwd: Hosted API: sudden p95/p99 latency spikes (initial triage)

Root cause suspects from quick triage: cross-region routing table change in our edge control plane.

What I see: between 08:40–09:05 PDT a deployment rolled out a route rule that incorrectly matched certain host prefixes for the us-west edge, causing a subset (~18% of sessions) to be routed via our eu-west POP. RTTs jumped accordingly and downstream p95/p99 numbers increased.

Evidence attached: p95_graphs.png (aggregated by geo), and a short runbook excerpt showing the offending rule. Logs: edge-proxy-logs show AS path via eu-west for client IPs that should hit us-west.

Immediate mitigation applied (11:30 PDT): reverted the route rule and pinned traffic to regional POPs while we validate. Early telemetry shows p95 dropping back toward baseline within 10–15 minutes for affected flows.

Next steps I recommend now:
- Keep the temporary pin for 2 hours and monitor (we already set alerts)
- Roll back the deployment that introduced the rule in the next safe window and add a unit test to the control-plane matcher
- Postmortem + RCA + customer-facing summary (Marissa to coordinate)

I will attach the troubleshooting_runbook.pdf and the log snippet to INF-1993.

-Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | Infrastructure Lead, Edge & Routing

Ali — quick update:

We identified a control-plane routing rule introduced in a recent edge deployment that matched a host prefix incorrectly and sent a fraction of US-west traffic through EU-west. Hannah reverted the rule and pinned traffic to the regional POPs at 11:30 PDT. Initial telemetry shows p95 returning to expected range (p95 back to ~140ms; previous baseline ~120ms). p99 still has a few tail events but those are decreasing.

We opened INF-1993 for tracking and will run a thorough RCA. As immediate remediation, we've kept the regional pin in place for two hours and will monitor.

We're committed to making this right: if you confirm your production numbers look restored we can discuss a credit for the impact window and a joint postmortem.

Please let me know if you see anything unusual on your side; Hannah and I are on standby.
